events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Agree access and start the evidence work
events.decision: Who will give the team access to the data and people the research needs?
agenda: Present the Spain question and the plan for the research phase
Align on the data and people the research needs
Confirm the date and focus of the week 3 check-in

events.label: Check-in: market sizing
events.purpose: Review market size and growth findings
events.decision: Is the market size and growth base solid enough to build the findings pack on?
agenda: Review market size and growth by segment
Discuss open questions for the remaining research
Confirm the base for the findings pack

events.label: Findings sign-off
events.purpose: Sign off findings on Spain's attractiveness
events.decision: Is Spain attractive enough to justify designing entry options?
agenda: Present competitor profiles, buyer needs and the gap assessment
Review the findings pack on Spain's attractiveness
Decide whether to design Spain entry options

events.label: Check-in: design progress
events.purpose: Check progress on the design workstreams
events.decision: Is the remaining work on track for a go or no-go at the final readout?
agenda: Present status of entry options and business case
Discuss emerging direction ahead of the final readout
Confirm what the final readout must settle

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Decide on Spain go or no-go and entry plan
events.decision: Approve the Spain go or no-go decision and, if go, the entry plan?
agenda: Present the go or no-go decision pack and entry plan
Review entry options, business case and roadmap
Decide go or no-go and, if go, the entry plan
